name: Dominion content: structure ladder, Founders and Vorta traits, Jem'Hadar line (MOD-3)

append.name: Vorta Administrative Center
append.description: Vorta governors and clerks run the colony by the book, and the book says the Founders are gods. Raises morale. The first rung of the Dominion ladder.

append.name: Ketracel-White Facility
append.description: Vats and distribution lines for the white that keeps the Jem'Hadar loyal and alive. Jem'Hadar warships cannot be built until one stands in the empire.

append.name: Jem'Hadar Barracks
append.description: Hatchery barracks that field shock troops who consider surrender a sin. Strengthens ground defence.

append.name: Vorta Commerce Bureau
append.description: Vorta factors assess every transaction in the colony and report the surplus to the Founders. Raises credit income.

append.name: Dominion Foundry
append.description: Orderly shifts of cloned labour keep the foundries running without a break. Raises industry.

append.name: Cloning Vats
append.description: Vorta and Jem'Hadar are grown to order; the same vats raise the colony's food stocks. Raises food output.

append.name: Genetic Research Station
append.description: The Dominion's ancient work on engineered life, continued under Vorta supervision. Raises research.

append.name: Vorta Intelligence Directorate
append.description: Vorta analysts watch every other Vorta and every foreign visitor. Raises internal security output across the empire.

append.name: Founders' Sanctuary
append.description: A hidden retreat where a Founder may rest among the Great Link's emissaries. Greatly raises morale here and unlocks the Shapeshifter Network.

append.name: Changeling Shapeshifter Network
append.description: Changelings placed in rival governments, fleets and boardrooms. Each Network adds to the empire's sabotage output and the damage its saboteurs do. Needs a Founders' Sanctuary in the same colony.

patch.description: The Jem'Hadar Attack Ship (the Bug): the cheap, fast fighter-cruiser that is the first rung of the Dominion's line. Needs a Ketracel-White Facility.
